explication: Localtunnel is a Node.js client that exposes a local HTTP or HTTPS service through a public URL. Users start it through the CLI or API; the client requests tunnel details from the remote server, opens forwarding connections, and relays traffic to the local service. The CLI reports the assigned URL and can optionally open it or print request events. The map follows the sampled runtime source and README; the remote server’s internal behavior is outside this repository.
